# Mehdi Nejadrasouli · Executive & Organizational Coach

Mehdi Nejadrasouli (also written Mehdi Nejad Rasouli; Persian: مهدی نژادرسولی) is an ICF PCC executive and organizational coach and senior HR leader. He works in Persian and English, from Tehran and remotely.

## Primary identity

- Name: Mehdi Nejadrasouli
- Alternate names: مهدی نژادرسولی; Mehdi Nejad Rasouli
- Roles: Executive Coach; Organizational Coach; Senior HR Leader
- Credential: ICF Professional Certified Coach (PCC)
- Experience: 700+ professional coaching hours; 15+ years in HR and people leadership
- Focus: executive coaching, organizational coaching, leadership transitions, strategic human resources, leadership development, organizational effectiveness

## Contact and discovery

- Discovery conversation: 30 minutes via Calendly at https://calendly.com/mehdi-nezhadrasouli/30min
- Email: mehdi.nezhadrasouli@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mehdi-nejad-rasouli-5b2421b9/

The discovery conversation clarifies the situation and tests fit. It does not automatically enrol a visitor in a programme. If there is a fit, the next step is a clear proposed scope covering focus, format, cadence, responsibilities and fees.

## Evidence and confidentiality

Every public asset should identify whether it is grounded in practice, research, a named source or clearly labelled reflection. Client identity and identifiable coaching material are not public content. In organizational coaching, session content remains confidential even when purpose and progress review are contracted with a sponsor.
